description.narrative: The investment program will help water supply companies in Viet Nam to improve their perfomance/ It will support capital investment in water companies and cofinance the National Nonrevenue Water (NRW) Program. The Program will utilize an MFF to provide longer-term support for institutional reform in Viet Namwater sector until 2020. The MFF will be used as seed money to leverage parallel cofinancing and, importantly, gain access to commercial finance and increased private sector participation.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved efficiency of participating water supply companies

Meet target Decree 117/2007 and Decree 124/2011: -Increase tariff every 2 years to achieve full cost recovery by 2020 -Define within 1 year of loan effectiveness and monitor through the project implementation a series of up to 10 KPIs to improve operational efficiency for each participating water supply company by 2020. Achievement: 90 Progress/Status: Achieved All WSCs started tariff increase every 2 years for all WSCs but delayed in 2020 by relevant provincial people's committee due to Covid-19. Full cost recovery is nearly achieved and all WSCs are making profits. No WSCs received subsidy from the government. Data Source: Local authorities' decision on tariff increase MTR - Loan review mission PCR Business Operation Plan

Initiate asset inventory and management of the water supply companies assets and implement Continuous Improvement Process (halving the gap of selected KPIs, based on annual targers) by 2020. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved 10 key performance indicators updated until 2018 by an ADB consultant (no data from 2018) shows accurate measurements and KPI reporting. Binh Duong, Hai Phong, Hue, and Dak Lak all established an asset management department, conducted robust asset inventories, implemented CIP and showed progress on KPIs Data Source: PCR Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Increased coverage to 90% by 2020. Indicator: By 2020: Increased water treatment and/or supply capacity totaling 420,100 m3/day. Achievement: 1070000 Progress/Status: Achieved Hai Phong: 250,000 m3/d, Binh Duong: 480,000 m3/d, Dak Lak: 60,000 m3/d, Thua Thien Hue: 280,000 m3/d.
Data Source: PCR

Output: Increased coverage to 90% by 2020. Indicator: Improved service delivery by increasing the service pressure, reducing NRW and increasing coverage for 1.5 million persons. Achievement: 2510000 Progress/Status: Improved service delivery: Partially achieved Increasing coverage in Binh Duong: 0.52 million, Thua Thien Hue: 0.71 million, Hai Phong: 0.93 million, Dak Lak: 0.35 million. Total 4 provinces: 2.51 million persons.
Reducing NRW: Achieved Binh Duong (5.54%), Thua Thien Hue (10.63%), Hai Phong (10.37%), and Dak Lak (18.5%)
Data Source: PCR

Output: Increased coverage to 90% by 2020. Indicator: Network extension to identified poor locations increases by 25% by 2020 from baseline data provided from each sub-project with reporting on sex disaggregated data (100% of FHH are connected over the project area). Achievement: 85.7 Progress/Status: Partially achieved 85.7% of total poor and FHHs identified in the same area of network extension have access to water. Data Source: PCR

Output: Increased coverage to 90% by 2020. Indicator: Poor with first time access to safe water 85,000 Achievement: 101600 Progress/Status: Achieved: Poor persons with first time access to safe water totaled 25,400 households (indicator is people, assume 4/household). Data Source: PCR

Output: Improved business planning, asset and financial management. Indicator: By 2020 Implementation of decrees 117/2007 and 124/2011 to ensure lifeline tariff and free connections are provided to 100% of identified poor households over the project area Achievement: 87.5 Progress/Status: Achieved All 4 provinces have policies to provide lifeline tariff and free connections for poor households in the provinces.
Data Source: Completion VIE: CDTA Water Supply; PCR; Annual Project Report

Output: Improved business planning, asset and financial management. Indicator: Investment in pipe repair and pipe replacement (women constitute 30% of new recruits for operations and maintenance). Achievement: 36.3 Progress/Status: Achieved 165 women among 455 staff from PMUs and water companies were newly recruited in O&M in the 4 project provinces (account for 36.3%)
Data Source: PCR

Output: Improved business planning, asset and financial management. Indicator: Roadmap for water tariff increase agreed at mid term review with gender and affordability considerations integrated; Self financing ratio set at 20%; Debt service ratio set at 1.2 Achievement: 45 Progress/Status: Tariff Road Map: Achieved Tariff road map agreed, and tariff raised until Covid-19 induced delay
Self-financing Ratio: Partially achieved Self-financing ratio: Binh Duong 32%, Thua Thien Hue 51%, Hai Phong 42%, Dak Lak: 55%
Debt Service Ratio: Achieved Debt service coverage ratio: Binh Duong 0.44, Thua Thien Hue 1.03, Hai Phong: 1.44, Dak Lak 1.1(full cost recovery was assured on final review mission)
Data Source: Loan Review Mission Report Annual Project Report Loan Review Mission Report MOC reports

Output: Improved business planning, asset and financial management. Indicator: Target 30% female staff for new recruits in each PMU and water companies/enterprises, especially in technical positions. Equal employment opportunities and equal pay for equal work, for local women and men in project civil works. Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: 30% Female Staff: Achieved Binh Duong targeted 28.6% female staff for new recruits; Dak Lak targeted 30.3%; Hue targeted 43.9%, and no new recruits in Hai Phong.
Equal Employment: Achieved Equal employment opportunities and equal pay for equal work were ensured by the project
Data Source: PCR

Output: Non-revenue water reduced. Indicator: Target NRW 25% by 2015 and 18% by 2020 from baseline of 30% (2010). Achievement: 11.26 Progress/Status: Achieved Binh Duong 5.54%, Thua Thien Hue: 10.63%. Hai Phong 10.37%, Dak Lak 18.5%.
Data Source: PCR
